title: East Coast Severe Weather Personal Hardship Assistance – Guidelines
summary: Find out about the East Coast Severe Weather Personal Hardship Assistance grant, including eligibility, funding, and application requirements.
who_can_apply: Be aged 18 or over on 18 May 2025.
Reside at an address in the Impacted Area on 18 May 2025.
Be impacted by the Disaster Event.
Require emergency financial assistance for your immediate needs and those of any Dependents.
what_you_need: Utility bill issued between 18 November 2024 and 18 May 2025.
Copy of residential tenancy agreement current as of 18 May 2025.
Vehicle registration notice issued between 18 May 2024 and 18 May 2025 (excluding Digital Vehicle Registration).
Letter from Centrelink, Medicare, Service NSW, Transport for NSW, Australian Taxation Office, or other government agency issued between 18 November 2024 and 18 May 2025.
Pensioner Concession card, Health Care card or Commonwealth Seniors Health Care card current as of 18 May 2025.
Council rates notice issued between 18 November 2024 and 18 May 2025.

faqs.q: How much financial assistance is available?
faqs.a: The grant provides $180 per Eligible Applicant, and $180 per additional Dependent up to a maximum of four, for a maximum payment of $900 per application.

faqs.q: When can I apply for this assistance?
faqs.a: Applications for the Program will be accepted from 9:00am on 30 May 2025.

You must be aged 18 or over on 18 May 2025, reside at an address in the Impacted Area on 18 May 2025, be impacted by the Disaster Event, and require emergency financial assistance for your immediate needs and those of any Dependents.
